Then bavette back in the sauce and serve.

Author: @Soulintent95
Content:
Nah dont use flap meat as an actual steak. In the northeast thats what we use for steak tips. Either use it as actual tips, or strips. Making a "steak" out of its gonna increase the likelihood it comes out chewy. Flap can be chewy when done wrong. 

I like to get decent sized tips, marinate them in teriyaki, and add some pickled ginger juice. 

Also i do thin sliced strips, sear them off in cast iron. Remove them. Then add tri color potatoes cut in half, seasoned with garlic, rosemary, and salt. Use plenty of butter. Parcooked potatoes to start, give them some time on the stove top, then put it in the oven. At the end, shred up the flap add it in, optionally add an egg and scramble it up in there. Then when its all done, add some cheese and let the risidual heat melt the cheese.
